referenceImages.name: Olympic Dam southwest service building
referenceImages.scope: Whole independently placed southwest service building at Olympic Dam, complete original 8-corner roof footprint including the original roof perimeter, closed industrial walls/roof, foundation, estimated service entrances and upper ventilation bays. Separate plant buildings, tanks, conveyors, headframes and exhaust stacks remain separate.

references.caption: View of Earth taken during ISS Expedition 38.
references.artist: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center

review.method: Previously cleared published NASA original and full native numerical roof outline
review.notes: Already cleared published Qualla NASA ISS038-E-29810 original supplies plant-level pale metal roof and industrial context. Original 6048x4032 image and central detail inspected. Specific façade, doors, roof section, building height, exact function, current condition and exact2014-to2026 footprint continuity are unmeasured estimates.
